pytest_python_missing: There is no Python to run pytest ({detail}). Set JGATES_PYTHON or put the project's Python on the PATH.
pytest_missing: pytest is not installed in Python {python}. Run: jgates doctor --fix (or pip install pytest in the project's Python environment). JGates installs nothing during a run.
pytest_no_tests: pytest collected no test (code 5): nothing was proven.
pytest_timeout: pytest exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
pytest_no_invocation: The plan has no pytest invocation for the instance {tool}.
pytest_invalid_junit: The pytest JUnit report could not be interpreted: {detail}
pytest_exit_mismatch: pytest ended with code 1, but the JUnit report has no failing test: the result cannot be interpreted.
pytest_reason_tests: pytest {version}: {total} test(s) run, {failed} failure(s), {errors} error(s), {skipped} skipped
pytest_condition_runs: Runs the component's pytest with the JUnit report in the run folder, with no cache or bytecode in the workspace.
pytest_condition_coverage: Measures line coverage with pytest-cov (source: {source}); the report and the .coverage file stay in the run folder.
pytest_condition_pythonpath: The code in {dir} enters the PYTHONPATH (src layout).
pytest_limitation_executes: pytest executes project code: the component's tests and conftest.py run.
pytest_limitation_cov_missing: Coverage will not be measured: the pytest-cov plugin is not active in this environment.
pytest_cov_missing: Coverage was not measured: the pytest-cov plugin is not active in Python {python}. Run: jgates doctor --fix (or pip install pytest-cov); JGates installs nothing during a run.
pytest_cov_unreadable: The coverage report was not generated or could not be read ({detail}): coverage was not measured.
pytest_cov_empty: The coverage report has no measured executable line: coverage was not measured (and it is not 0%).
pytest_cov_reason_nomin: Line coverage {percent}% ({covered} of {statements}); the policy defines no minimum
pytest_cov_below: The line coverage of the component {component} is {percent}% ({covered} of {statements} lines), below the policy minimum of {minimum}% ({source}).
pytest_cov_blocked_by_exit: Coverage was not measured because pytest did not end normally.
pytest_exclusion_pragma: {count} line(s) excluded by pragma or by the coverage configuration
